svg.title: The check of the built website
svg.desc: In every pull request and with every change of main, the check docs builds the website strictly with MkDocs, Material and mkdocs-static-i18n, and after the build the hooks of .github/mkdocs_project.py write security.txt, robots.txt, llms.txt, the pages at the old addresses and the search of every project into the folder site. There blueprint.py site-check checks what the hooks of every website promise, lychee every link and anchor, and scripts/check-site.sh what the hooks of this website promise: security.txt, robots.txt, llms.txt, the sitemaps, the old addresses, the 404 page, the home pages and the search; then it uses the hub in Chrome, at the width of a phone and of a desktop. A broken promise fails the check with the file and the fix, a failed scenario with what broke, and GitHub Pages publishes only a website that keeps every promise.
